description: Shared query vectors for wgo dash (spec/gh-100.md). internal/dash/query_test.go runs them in Go and internal/review/testdata/live_logic.js runs them in node; both must pass. Expectations list node IDs sorted; 'visible' is 'all' when the query does not filter the graph. 'error' must appear in the message, 'pos' is the 1-based column and 'fixed' the suggested expression. A case with 'base': true uses the canonical registry alone; 'env' replaces snapshot fields before indexing; 'preset' names the built-in saved filter whose expression 'query' must equal.
fields_note: fields are test-only registrations that replace or add to the registry for these vectors: requested_count exercises the count derive. planned names a test-only planned field, since every catalogue field is registered now. The snapshot's facts (gh-99) are hand-written in ComputeFacts' JSON shape to exercise the query language; their values are invented, not derived (stale ignores stale_days, and pr:acme/api#38 and pr:acme/web#9 have no facts, like a snapshot from before gh-99).
